_doc: Measurement campaign grid. Prices: runpod.io/pricing Serverless, 2026-10-07. boot_s / exec_s: this repo's gold tables (emberserve baked ~17 s to ready, fetched ~38 s, worker-vllm fetched ~150-210 s; 16-token request ~2-5 s). Billed seconds per cold start = boot + exec + idle timeout (Runpod bills worker start, execution and idle per second; the image pull is not billed). FlashBoot-on cells are upper bounds: a resume replaces most of boot_s. reference_endpoint: the endpoint Runpod built from GitHub for that image; the campaign re-points it per cell (PATCH gpu pool + flashboot) because registry.runpod.net images can only be pulled by the endpoint that built them (a new endpoint with the same image or template fails with 'Failed to get Hub registry auth').
